Name: Bucktooth Morris
Author: AnotherStardewValleySunday
Description:
Does what it says on the box. Purely cosmetic, but definitely worth it. As for me, I have no regrets.

Based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister's  ﻿[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]. This is a dependency. To install Bucktoothed Morris, copy-paste the files included into the Seasonal Outfits folder and overwrite the files (make sure to back up the originals!) and play the game as normal.

Downloads.Description: The main file. Use to overwrite files from Seasonal Outfits.
